read.name: gmail_list_folders
read.description: List the folders of the connected Gmail mailbox (read-only).

read.name: gmail_search
read.description: Search the connected Gmail mailbox and answer message UIDs (read-only).

read.name: gmail_list_messages
read.description: List the newest messages of a Gmail folder with sender, date and subject (read-only).

read.name: gmail_get_message
read.description: Read one message of a Gmail folder: headers and its plain text body (read-only).

read.name: gmail_list_attachments
read.description: List the attachments of one Gmail message with their names, types and sizes (read-only).

read.name: gmail_read_attachment
read.description: Read a text attachment of one Gmail message (read-only; other types are refused with their type and size).

write.name: gmail_list_folders
write.description: List the folders of the connected Gmail mailbox (read-only).

write.name: gmail_search
write.description: Search the connected Gmail mailbox and answer message UIDs (read-only).

write.name: gmail_list_messages
write.description: List the newest messages of a Gmail folder with sender, date and subject (read-only).

write.name: gmail_get_message
write.description: Read one message of a Gmail folder: headers and its plain text body (read-only).

write.name: gmail_list_attachments
write.description: List the attachments of one Gmail message with their names, types and sizes (read-only).

write.name: gmail_read_attachment
write.description: Read a text attachment of one Gmail message (read-only; other types are refused with their type and size).

write.name: gmail_mark_read
write.description: Mark messages as read in a Gmail folder (write; the user is asked first).

write.name: gmail_mark_unread
write.description: Mark messages as unread in a Gmail folder (write; the user is asked first).

write.name: gmail_move_messages
write.description: Move messages from one Gmail folder to another (write; the user is asked first).

write.name: gmail_delete_messages
write.description: Move messages to Trash, or delete them for good with permanent (write; the user is asked first).

write.name: gmail_save_draft
write.description: Save a plain-text draft in Gmail without sending it (write; the user is asked first). Saving the same draft twice creates a second draft: this tool does not deduplicate.

write.name: gmail_add_labels
write.description: Add Gmail labels to messages in a Gmail folder (write; the user is asked first).

write.name: gmail_remove_labels
write.description: Remove Gmail labels from messages in a Gmail folder (write; the user is asked first).

write.name: gmail_archive
write.description: Archive messages by removing the Inbox label, so they stay in All Mail (write; the user is asked first).

write.name: gmail_send_email
write.description: Send an email from the connected Gmail address. Every call asks for approval first; sending cannot be undone.

write.name: gmail_reply_email
write.description: Reply to a message from the connected Gmail address. The caller supplies the original Message-ID and References. Every call asks for approval first; sending cannot be undone.

write.name: gmail_forward_email
write.description: Forward a message from the connected Gmail address, keeping the attachments the caller passes. Every call asks for approval first; sending cannot be undone.
